build.pre_e33_build_note: The first pre-E33 attempt finished in 0.98 s without compiling: the -C metadata hash of a path package does not depend on its directory and the four replaced files were older than build 1's outputs, so cargo judged build 1's artifacts fresh. Caught because nothing compiled; the four files were touched and the build rerun (10 min). The resulting binary differs from E33's (sha256 23b22013…) and contains none of E33's solver names (strings chain-sparsest-counted absent), and its macaulay/chain/chain-sparsest records equal E33's build's while emitting no E33 field. Build 3 rebuilt c443138920 over it; its e33_stage_a and quartic_pipeline_gls are byte-identical to build 1's.

sample.rule: key(label) = sha256('<nonce>:<label>'), curves sorted by key ascending (replay/draw_sample.sh); end to end: the first four curves of e2e_order for all three solvers, then further curves in that order as time allowed; existing-solver identity: the first curve of identity_order_excluding_p101s2; controls: the first two curves of controls_order with their controls_rng seeds

comparison.rule: every leaf of every committed record against the replay: integers and floats by their text (equal text, or equal value with the same integer/float form), strings and booleans exactly; keys ending in _ms, 'ms' and keys containing 'wall' are wall-clock and listed, not compared; a key present on one side only is a mismatch

coverage: Stage A replayed in full (10 curves x 1,000 calls x 7 solvers, every solver); end to end 30 of the 30 recorded runs (the sample in replay/sample.json); existing-solver identity of the pre-E33 build (bd0118f39) and E33's build on 4 configurations; negative controls on validator-drawn calls

existing_solver_identity.detail: old_* and new_* outputs under replay/identity: every leaf equal (wall-clock aside) and no E33 field in the new build's records; the new records against the stored E25/E31/E27 records of the same configuration are listed in replay_comparison.json

scalar_verification: Every replayed end-to-end arm reports folded.solved and folded.correct (the binary sets correct only when the Wiedemann logarithm equals the planted d and [x]G = Q holds), and all 48 pipeline walks of the arm are correct with the same logarithm: two independent algorithms agree; the validator report checks that logarithm against E27's walk (iii) on all 60 committed arm records.
